description: Unofficial Kyubey fan art from Puella Magi Madoka Magica. A white four-pawed messenger curls one large tail, gently nudges a pink light dot, steps through a small loose light ring and performs quadrupedal directional trots and a soft hop. Nine original peaceful animated states preserve the separate ringed head appendages. No contract scenes or official affiliation.
author: Cozy Critters Studio
